name: spellkave_author_place
label: Author Place (verb PoC)
description: PoC (#1968): author ONE place_graph + its place_nodes (+ optional place_edges) in a single call, wrapping the existing patchManifest place ops. Self-scaffolds the `[[bundles]]` header if `bundle` has none yet (FIX②b). Nodes get metric positions (explicit x/y or auto circle/line) and optional elevation. substrate defaults to outdoor; pass substrate:'indoor' for buildings. PoC boundary: one place_graph per call. map_graph draws outdoor world-compose by default; pass graph=<id> to draw an indoor plan. Top-level `description` sets the GRAPH's own description; each `nodes[].description` sets that ONE node's own arrival prose instead (T5 follow-up) — author both when a node deserves its own sensory detail beyond the graph-level blurb.

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on every generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

substrate.description: substrate_id for the graph and every node (core: outdoor | indoor | tactical). Default 'outdoor'. Houses/interiors should use 'indoor'.

parent_graph_id.description: Composition parent place_graph_id (ADR-0029 / Item 25). Empty/omit = root. Nested outdoor graphs project into the parent frame on the world map.

origin_cell_res10.description: Root outdoor H3 res10 anchor as decimal u64 string. Only composition roots should set this; res7/res4 parents are derived. Nested graphs omit (origin stays 0).

bearing.description: Clockwise rotation degrees relative to parent/world frame (ADR-0029). Default 0.

metres_per_unit.description: Graph unit → metres (ADR-0029). Default 1. Outdoor world maps often use >1.

display_name.description: place_graph display_name; default title-cased graph local id.

id.description: Fully-qualified place-node id '<place_graph_id>/<local_id>' (e.g. 'aoe_blast/arena/center'). PoC boundary: bare local ids are not supported.

name.description: display_name; defaults to a title-cased local id.

x.description: Optional metric graph-local pos_x (integer graph units). When any node omits x/y, author_place auto-layouts all nodes on a circle (n>=3) or a line (n=1..2).

y.description: Optional metric graph-local pos_y (integer graph units). See `x`.

elevation.description: Optional graph-local pose_elevation (metres-ish via graph metres_per_unit). Use for floors/cellars (e.g. 0 ground, -3 cellar). Omit for 0 with pose_elevation_present=true.

cell_res10.description: Optional outdoor H3 res10 cell as decimal u64 string (parents res7/res4 derived via h3-js). Prefer strings so values above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER stay exact.

description.description: Sets THIS node's own `place_nodes.description` column (T5 follow-up, #1968 pattern: a first-class field, never a metadata_attachments detour — same shape as the top-level `description` param below, which sets the GRAPH's own description instead). Read by movement-observation tools (e.g. spellkave_move) as the arrival prose for THIS node; falls back to the graph's own description only on a graph-crossing move when omitted.

extent_shape_id.description: place_nodes.extent_shape_id (place-node-extent D-2, sk-71u): an explicit spatial extent for THIS node — one of the KNOWN_AREA_SHAPE_IDS kernel shapes (e.g. 'core/area/sphere', 'core/area/cube'). Overrides the bundle's own default_extent_shape_id (spellkave_define_bundle) for this node only. Pair with `extent_params_json`; omit both to fall back to the bundle default.

extent_params_json.description: place_nodes.extent_params_json — the params_json paired with `extent_shape_id` (e.g. '{"radius_m": 2.5}' for core/area/sphere). Only meaningful alongside `extent_shape_id`.

nodes.description: One or more place nodes. Every id must share ONE common parent path (one place_graph per call — a PoC boundary); the FIRST node becomes the place_graph's anchor_node_id.

edges.description: [from_node_id, to_node_id] pairs; both ends must be in `nodes`. Pass [] for disconnected nodes (e.g. two same-radius cells with no traversal edge between them, as the worked example does).

description.description: Sets the generated place_graph's own `description` column (#1968 — a first-class, never load-bearing authoring field, not a metadata_attachments row).

promptSnippet: Author one place_graph with nodes and edges (outdoor or indoor)
promptGuidelines: Use spellkave_author_place for topology (nodes+edges); pass nodes[].x/y for layout or omit for auto circle; nodes[].elevation for floors.
Houses/interiors: substrate:'indoor'. Outdoor regions: omit or substrate:'outdoor'.
Author nodes[].description for a node's own 1-2 sentence arrival prose; it wins over the graph-level description on that node's own moves.
After authoring, spellkave_map_graph shows the picture (pass graph= for indoor); for live worlds call spellkave_apply_manifest_delta with no args to commit the scratch.
Deeper spatial playbook: spellkave_docs doc=place-graph-occupancy (read path) or spatial-minimal-cell (row shape).
